sources.title: GTFS Schedule Reference
sources.released_version_or_commit: Page states revised April 27, 2026; no numbered release.
locator: Term Definitions: service day and Time
sources.observed_operation: Official reference distinguishes service date/time from civil clock date, assigns stop_times to agency timezone, defines the ferry route type and describes publishing stable/current feeds.
sources.condition_default_exception: A service day can run past midnight with times above 24:00; stop_times use agency.agency_timezone rather than stop_timezone; the time base has a daylight-saving caveat; route_type 4 denotes ferry.
sources.applicability: Directly governs the proposed GTFS Schedule based ferry departure display; actual operator identifiers/calendar remain unknown.

critic_review.review_note: Schedule reference: service day and >24:00 time, agency timezone vs stop_timezone, ferry type 4, feed_info version recommendation.

sources.title: GTFS Overview
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current maintained overview as accessed; no numbered version.
sources.observed_operation: Schedule is a static ZIP with routes/trips/stops/stop_times/calendars; Realtime describes trip updates, service alerts and vehicle positions; reference docs are declared the source of truth.
sources.condition_default_exception: Realtime capabilities are optional in this proposed consumer; the overview is descriptive, with detailed semantics delegated to the separate references.
sources.applicability: Frames two ingestion/display routes and supports schedule-only fallback as a product design inference.

critic_review.review_note: Official overview: static Schedule files and supported Realtime entity categories.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Reference
sources.released_version_or_commit: GTFS Realtime 2.0; current maintained reference at access. Source code/reference branch is mutable; no immutable commit observed.
sources.observed_operation: Every feed relates to an existing static GTFS; FeedHeader.timestamp is generation time; optional feed_version matches static feed_info.feed_version; trip descriptors identify scheduled/frequency instances with different required keys.
sources.condition_default_exception: Frequency trips require trip_id+start_date+start_time. For scheduled trips, start_date is required for ambiguity/collision cases and if trip_id omitted; route_id alone in TripDescriptor is not a route-wide alert selector. Unresolved zero/multiple trip matches can be discarded.
sources.applicability: Directly governs realtime/static matching and version mismatch states; producer's actual feed version field and ID discipline are unknown.

critic_review.review_note: Realtime reference: FeedHeader version, TripDescriptor conditions, stop identity, NEW/REPLACEMENT semantics and required StopTimeUpdates.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Best Practices
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current maintained recommendations at access; no numbered release.
sources.observed_operation: Recommended refresh interval is at most 30 seconds and embedded TripUpdate/VehiclePosition data age no more than 90 seconds; Service Alerts no more than 10 minutes. Provides advice on stable IDs and trip schedule relationship values.
sources.condition_default_exception: These are best-practice recommendations, not an operator-specific service guarantee. Header refresh alone does not prove embedded event freshness.
sources.applicability: Starting point only for proposed pilot freshness checks; local stale threshold needs duty manager and partner agreement.

critic_review.review_note: Best practices: 30-second refresh and embedded age recommendations; guidance, not a local SLA.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Trip Updates
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current maintained guidance at access; no numbered release.
sources.observed_operation: No TripUpdate means no real-time information, not on-time; stop updates can contain time/delay; NO_DATA marks unknown portions; repeated/frequency trip IDs require service-date/time.
sources.condition_default_exception: Delay is meaningful only relative to matching scheduled static time; missing stop updates and NO_DATA mean unknown; a missing update cannot justify an ETA.
sources.applicability: Directly governs board's prediction suppression and trip identity.

critic_review.review_note: Trip Updates: missing update is not on-time; stop event and NO_DATA semantics.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Service Alerts
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current maintained guidance at access; revision history lists June 2026 active-period additions.
sources.observed_operation: Trip-specific delays/cancellations ordinarily use TripUpdates. An alert time range defines display period; without one, the documented display duration is while present. Multiple selectors are independent; multiple fields within one selector are ANDed.
sources.condition_default_exception: Only GTFS-ID-matching entities apply; route+stop constrains alert to that route at that stop. Alert is a broader notice and must not become an estimated trip time.
sources.applicability: Directly governs two-terminal route/stop banner applicability.

critic_review.review_note: Service Alerts: time ranges and EntitySelector AND/separate-selector behavior.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Full Revision History
sources.released_version_or_commit: Maintained history accessed 2026-10-10; relevant entries Dec 2024 and May 2025, with later entries through June 2026.
locator: May 2025: ADDED deprecated / NEW and REPLACEMENT
sources.observed_operation: Records the release of FeedHeader schedule feed version linkage and later trip schedule relationship clarifications.
sources.condition_default_exception: History identifies spec changes, not which partner/consumer has deployed each version.
sources.applicability: Historical applicability for version-aware static/RT cutover and feed producer compatibility.

critic_review.review_note: Official revision history: December 2024 feed_version; current reference also records later trip relationships.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime PR #434 and issue #362
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR #434 merged 2024-12-05; related source commit displayed as 1c7d8b5; current GTFS-RT revision record says Dec 2024.
locator: PR conversation: initial version and URL proposal; URL removal; Swiss producer and TransSee consumer report; merge metadata
sources.observed_operation: An issue identified lack of static schedule version in realtime. The change retained optional feed_version matching static feed_info.feed_version and removed gtfs_url after current/upcoming URL ambiguity. Swiss producer and TransSee consumer reported switching static GTFS when version changed.
sources.condition_default_exception: feed_version is optional. Schedule publishing and realtime activation can occur at different times; the PR does not mandate a cutover algorithm.
sources.applicability: A relevant released failure/change chain for timetable revision synchronization; local proposal to compare versions and withhold incompatible RT is an inference.

critic_review.review_note: The official revision history and supplemental S21 confirm the field/proposal context. Direct GitHub PR fetch timed out; removal rationale and Swiss/TransSee account were not independently corroborated.

sources.title: OneBusAway Application Modules README
sources.released_version_or_commit: README on moving main, accessed 2026-10-10; deployment guide identifies v2.x. Not release-pinned.
locator: GTFS Data / static and real-time data changes
sources.observed_operation: OneBusAway offers a large-screen sign-mode and REST API; setup uses GTFS_URL, agency timezone, separate tripUpdatesUrl/vehiclePositionsUrl/alertsUrl, agencyId, refresh interval and optional auth headers.
sources.condition_default_exception: Project expects schedule GTFS and realtime source for standard full service; stated Docker setup is under development; no ferry feed or mismatch behavior verified.
sources.applicability: Plausible second display/ingestion route; requires a pilot fit test and operational overhead review.

critic_review.review_note: OneBusAway main README: sign-mode, API, static and separate realtime feed configuration; moving documentation.

sources.title: OneBusAway Application Modules Releases
sources.released_version_or_commit: Latest listed release at access is v2.7.1, commit 095bf1a.
sources.observed_operation: Release page distinguishes tagged product release from moving main docs and lists current version commit.
sources.condition_default_exception: Release metadata alone does not establish ferry feature compatibility or current docs behavior.
sources.applicability: Pins the candidate product alternative's reviewed release label; use the release itself in any later validation.

critic_review.review_note: OneBusAway release page: v2.7.1 marked latest at review and commit 095bf1a.

sources.title: DfT Technical Guidance: SIRI-VM
sources.released_version_or_commit: DfT BODS-specific SIRI-VM 2.0(Q) profile; maintained web guidance, accessed 2026-10-10.
sources.observed_operation: SIRI is modular; guidance describes scheduled and realtime exchange family, SIRI-VM subscription/incremental updates, 30-second heartbeat/update expectations, UTC timestamps, and ID matching.
sources.condition_default_exception: This concrete implementation is a UK bus profile, not the complete CEN standard and not a ferry implementation. Different SIRI profiles remain valid for other workflows.
sources.applicability: Analogue only; informs an alternate if the partner already publishes SIRI but does not establish local capability.

critic_review.review_note: DfT BODS SIRI-VM technical profile: cadence/heartbeat and profile-specific fields; bus applicability.

sources.title: DfT Bus Open Data Implementation Guide
sources.released_version_or_commit: DfT guidance for TransXChange 2.4 and SIRI-VM 2.0/2.0Q; maintained publication, accessed 2026-10-10.
sources.observed_operation: The bus profile matches timetable and realtime using same IDs for OperatorRef, BlockRef and VehicleJourneyRef; operational ID changes require revised timetable data; incomplete IDs reduce matching quality.
sources.condition_default_exception: For UK buses and the BODS profile; cannot be applied as ferry-specific requirement.
sources.applicability: Analogous schedule-plus-event/update integration mechanism and an explicit warning that shared identity must be operationally managed.

critic_review.review_note: DfT implementation guide: TransXChange/SIRI-VM shared identifier/revision relationship; bus-profile limit.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner v2.10.0 release and changelog
sources.released_version_or_commit: v2.10.0, release commit 521cd5d, dated 2026-09-09.
sources.observed_operation: Pins a current OTP candidate release; official changelog describes feature/fix changes incorporated in each version, and the 2.10.0 changelog lists release contents.
sources.condition_default_exception: A tagged version alone does not prove local configuration, data-feed compatibility, or suitable display behavior.
sources.applicability: Use v2.10.0 for any OTP fit check; do not treat latest docs as proof of ferry-specific operation.

critic_review.review_note: OTP release page: v2.10.0, commit 521cd5d, 2026-09-09.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner v2.10.0 GTFS-RT updater configuration
sources.released_version_or_commit: OTP 2.10.0 versioned documentation.
sources.observed_operation: Separate updaters consume alert, trip-update and vehicle-position feeds. HTTP polling frequency defaults to PT1M; TripUpdates and Alerts require feedId; fuzzy trip matching defaults false; headers can be supplied.
sources.condition_default_exception: Backwards delay propagation default is required-no-data; forwards default propagates estimates with documented special handling for NO_DATA/SKIPPED. Updater acceptance and output are dependent on matching and stop-time conditions.
sources.applicability: Concrete candidate integration behavior for partner-confirmed feed types. It does not set this board's freshness threshold or manual advisory policy.

critic_review.review_note: OTP v2.10.0 GTFS-RT updater types, feedId, polling defaults and matching configuration.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner v2.10.0 Feed ID
sources.released_version_or_commit: OTP 2.10.0 versioned documentation.
sources.observed_operation: OTP scopes static feed identifiers and uses them to associate real-time feeds with static datasets. A build-config value has priority; feed_info.feed_id is non-standard; automatic increasing numeric IDs are fallback.
sources.condition_default_exception: feedId is a dataset namespace configured at graph build and is not the GTFS Schedule feed_info.feed_version or realtime FeedHeader.feed_version.
sources.applicability: Choose a stable explicit feedId for the one-route feed and bind updater to it; separately expose/compare feed_version for revision status.

critic_review.review_note: OTP v2.10.0 Feed ID documentation: static namespace and explicit build-config preference, distinct from dataset version.

sources.title: OTP old vehicle-position cleanup fix PR #6523
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR merged 2025-03-14 as commit 273f879; included in the OTP v2.8.0 release line (2025-09-10); current candidate 2.10.0 is later.
locator: OTP changelog v2.8.0 detailed changes, PR #6523
sources.observed_operation: Maintainer reports old vehicle data from the previous poll/download was not correctly removed. The fix changed the repository update to copy-on-write semantics, added tests and exposed last vehicle-position update time in ISO format.
sources.condition_default_exception: This concerns VehiclePositions snapshot replacement and a returned last-update timestamp; it is not evidence of a configured max-age cutoff for TripUpdates/Alerts or a timetable-version gate.
sources.applicability: Released consumer-history evidence for stale vehicle-position handling; still propose explicit freshness monitoring and test the actual selected release.

critic_review.review_note: PR text and v2.8.0 changelog confirm the VehiclePositions cleanup and release inclusion; exact SHA detail is carried from investigator metadata, not independently rechecked.

sources.title: OTP GraphQL feed-version exposure PR #7445
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR #7445 merged 2026-03-30; included in OTP 2.10.0; initial commit shown as 2bc44a8.
locator: PR summary: client identifies data version used by an OTP instance
sources.observed_operation: Adds the static GTFS feed version to GraphQL output so a client can identify the data revision in a specific OTP instance and avoid unnecessary refreshes.
sources.condition_default_exception: This exposes the loaded static feed version; it does not compare it against an incoming realtime FeedHeader or automatically switch timetable revisions.
sources.applicability: Useful observability for a display client, but product logic must still compare/handle version mismatch.

critic_review.review_note: OTP PR #7445 and v2.10.0 changelog: static GTFS version exposed through GraphQL.

sources.title: OTP missing-start_date vehicle-position failure and linked fix
sources.released_version_or_commit: Issue opened 2022-04-01 against commit b0c9829e3bfe10daddae72485a09a7f48b0be8ff; issue closed as completed in PR #4066 on 2022-04-22. A released tag containing the fix was not directly established in the inspected changelog.
locator: discussion of conditional start_date, service day, midnight/server-time concern
sources.observed_operation: OTP discarded GTFS-RT VehiclePosition entities lacking start_date even where the feed's scheduled trip could otherwise be matched. Maintainers explained that realtime trip-time updates may create per-service-day logical trips; the linked fix inferred a service day.
sources.condition_default_exception: Condition applies to a vehicle-position entity missing start_date and to OTP's internal trip-instance/service-day resolution. It is not evidence of a static feed-version bug; release inclusion remains unknown from this read.
sources.applicability: Shows why trip_id alone is not enough for every message and why service date/time-zone cases must be tested; not a product-validation result.

critic_review.review_note: OTP issue #4058/closed-by #4066 record; release inclusion remains unestablished as the investigator states.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner v2.10.0 SIRI updater configuration
sources.released_version_or_commit: OTP 2.10.0 versioned documentation; updater supports the Nordic and EPIP SIRI profiles as subsets.
sources.observed_operation: OTP documents request/response SIRI-ET and SIRI-SX updaters; both use a feedId, default to PT1M polling, and identify profiles rather than the entire SIRI standard.
sources.condition_default_exception: Requires a compatible profile/server; docs do not claim any arbitrary SIRI implementation or ferry provider can be consumed directly.
sources.applicability: A possible if-partner-already-has-it analogue/adapter route; require profile and field mapping confirmation.

critic_review.review_note: OTP v2.10.0 SIRI docs: ET/SX updater supports Nordic and EPIP subsets, not arbitrary SIRI.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner v2.10.0 project overview
sources.released_version_or_commit: Project repository describes OTP2 as the current supported major line; reviewed tag v2.10.0 is pinned separately in S13.
locator: README description of multimodal journey-planning APIs and GTFS/OSM data
sources.observed_operation: OTP is an open-source multimodal public-transport trip planner, with GTFS and other open standard inputs and APIs consumed by client applications.
sources.condition_default_exception: Its purpose is trip planning; the documentation does not describe a ferry terminal departure board as a turnkey output.
sources.applicability: Supports OTP as an ingestion/data backend candidate only when paired with a board frontend.

critic_review.review_note: OTP project description: multimodal journey-planning backend, not a turnkey terminal board.

sources.title: GTFS Digest — February 2024
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official GTFS Digest, February 2024 edition, posted 2024-03-01.
locator: Add Feed Version and GTFS url to the GTFS real time FeedHeader #434
sources.observed_operation: The official digest describes PR #434's initial proposal as adding feed_version matching GTFS feed_info.feed_version and a GTFS_url pointing to the schedule file.
sources.condition_default_exception: This is proposal context from before the eventual December 2024 field adoption; it does not establish why GTFS_url was later removed or the PR discussion's implementation anecdotes.
sources.applicability: Partial corroboration for the initial proposal history; the official revision history S07 is relied upon for the adopted field.

critic_review.review_note: Supports only initial proposal context, not all S08 discussion claims.

access_window_utc.precision_note: The browser did not expose per-fetch timestamps; exact window endpoints are clock observations.
